c250 splitPlaying single-sample assert (rms > 0.0005 at one instant) is phase-sensitive: the demo music is a pulse train (peaks 0.15 every 0.5 s, 0.0003 in the gaps). It read False in the first c250 run and in the c250-series run at both viewports, then True in a quiet rerun. A continuous 40 ms sampling probe (c250-split.cjs splitPlayingMax, 115 samples) shows audio continues after Split during playback: pre-split max 0.143, post-split max 0.154, 69 of 75 post-split samples above 0.0005, playhead advances 7.53 -> 10.63; no-split control max 0.151. Not a product bug; the assert design is a harness weakness for B (suggest a max over a window).
